question.question: When are Action hands refilled and the First Player token passed; what happens when the Action deck empties, and what are the normal discard destinations and visibility?

answer_key_entry.expected_answer: At Player Phase start draw to 5, shuffle Action discard whenever required draw finds empty deck; then pass token left except first turn. Actions/Contamination to own Action discard, Items/Event/Attack/Serious Wounds to respective discard piles face up; markers to pools. Search example has explicit face-down return exception.

requested_parts: Refill, token passing and empty deck
a.answer:
1. At Player Phase start draw to 5. After draw pass First Player token left except first turn. If Action deck empties when required to draw, shuffle discard into new deck then draw.
2. Normal card discards face-up: Action and gained Contamination to own Action discard; Items to matching Item discard; Event/Intruder Attack/Serious Wound to own respective discards. Discarded markers to matching pools. Search/Storage rejected Item face-down to bottom of selected deck; removed-from-game cards/tokens do not return.
a.evidence:
1. Draw to 5 at the start of the Player Phase; when a required Action draw finds the deck empty, shuffle that Character's Action discard into a new deck. Pass the First Player token left after drawing, except on turn 1. **Normal card discards are face up:** Action/Contamination → own Action discard; Items → matching Item discard; Event, Intruder Attack and Serious Wound → their respective discard piles. **Discarded markers → matching supply pools.** Follow explicit exceptions such as Search/Storage's face-down bottom-deck return and cards removed from the game. - **I. Player Phase:** 1) draw up to 5 Action cards; 2) pass First Player token left (not on turn 1); 3) rounds of 2 Actions (or 1 Action + pass, or pass) clockwise until all players pass — after passing you sit out normal rounds for the rest of the Phase (Interruption remains permitted).
2. Draw to 5 at the start of the Player Phase; when a required Action draw finds the deck empty, shuffle that Character's Action discard into a new deck. Pass the First Player token left after drawing, except on turn 1. **Normal card discards are face up:** Action/Contamination → own Action discard; Items → matching Item discard; Event, Intruder Attack and Serious Wound → their respective discard piles. **Discarded markers → matching supply pools.** Follow explicit exceptions such as Search/Storage's face-down bottom-deck return and cards removed from the game. **Routing rule:** Action and gained Contamination cards go to that Character's Action discard; Items go to the matching Item discard; Event, Intruder Attack and Serious Wound cards each go to their own discard. **Discarded markers return to their matching supply pools.** An explicit effect can give a different destination: Search and Storage keep one of two Item cards and return the other face down to the bottom of the chosen deck. Removed-from-game Contamination and Exploration tokens do not return to their supplies.

b.answer: 1) At Player Phase start everyone draws to five (six with Cabins). 2) After drawing, pass First Player token left except first game turn. 3) When deck empty for required draw, shuffle discard into a new deck and draw. 4) Normal card discards are face up; Action and gained Contamination go to own Action discard, Items to matching discard, Event/Attack/Serious Wound to respective piles. Explicit exceptions: search rejected card face down bottom of deck.
b.evidence: [1] Every player draws from their Action deck up to a hand of 5 cards; Cabins gives a hand of 6. [2] After drawing, pass First Player token to the player on the left; do not pass it on the first turn. [3] Whenever you must draw and your Action deck is empty, shuffle your discard pile into a new Action deck, then draw. [4] Normal card discards are face up; Action and gained Contamination cards go to that Character's Action discard pile; Items to matching Item discard; Event, Intruder Attack and Serious Wound cards to their own discard piles. Search/Storage return rejected card face down to bottom of chosen deck.
